props.text: A live instrument for the local Ignition 8.3 test node

transforms.code:
millis = value.getTime()
	scene = int(self.view.custom.scene) % 3
	periods = (12000, 6500, 9000)
	directions = (1, -1, 1)
	period = periods[scene]
	angle = int((millis % period) * 360.0 / period)
	angle = (angle * directions[scene]) + (scene * 45)
	return "rotate(%ddeg)" % angle

millis = value.getTime()
	scene = int(self.view.custom.scene) % 3
	period = (2000, 900, 3200)[scene]
	phase = (millis % period) / (period / 2.0)
	if phase > 1.0:
		phase = 2.0 - phase
	low = (0.25, 0.15, 0.45)[scene]
	return low + (phase * (1.0 - low))

millis = value.getTime()
	scene = int(self.view.custom.scene) % 3
	period = (5000, 2600, 7000)[scene]
	amplitude = (32, 48, 18)[scene]
	phase = (millis % period) / (period / 2.0)
	if phase > 1.0:
		phase = 2.0 - phase
	offset = int(-amplitude + (phase * amplitude * 2))
	skew = (0, 6, -6)[scene]
	return "translateX(%dpx) skewX(%ddeg)" % (offset, skew)

props.text: Three independent client bindings. No GIFs. No video. Every frame is computed inside the Perspective session.

transforms.code:
if value is None:
		return u"--d --h --m"
	seconds = max(0, int(value))
	days = seconds // 86400
	hours = (seconds % 86400) // 3600
	minutes = (seconds % 3600) // 60
	return u"%02dd %02dh %02dm" % (days, hours, minutes)
